jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Vancouver, BC

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager I, RMM
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you serve as the customer’s main point of contact, trusted advisor, and drive the strategic partnership, momentum across our internal teams, and outcomes tied to the customer’s goals.  You are a strong relationship builder, understand a customer’s goals and priorities, and translate them into strategic recommendations that will drive a high level of product adoption, satisfaction, referrals and customer retention, grow the account through expansion, and help us get ahead of churn. To thrive as a Customer Success Manager at Toast, you are flexible, a self-starter who builds structure where there are no playbooks or clear direction, and advocates for the customer within Toast!   

 The Regional Mid-Market (RMM)  segment operates in a highly cross-functional role responsible for a regionally based book of business, ranging from 16-50 locations. As a Senior CSM, you’re accountable for the health and growth of your book. You quarterback each partnership end to end: you know the customer’s business and goals, multi-thread to their decision-makers, get ahead of risk before it becomes churn, collaborate cross-functionally and drive expansion. You’re the person who moves the partnership forward.

 

What you'll do (Responsibilities)

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with the customer’s owners, executives, and decision-makers, not just the day-to-day contact, and bring in Toast execs as needed
  • Retain and grow SaaS revenue through consultative engagement and product recommendation by  understanding needs of each customer 
  • Drive activation and adoption across Toast product suite by tying adoption to the customer’s business goals, not just module usage, using data to spot risk and growth early, and leveraging internal tools/customer marketing strategies
  • Leverage your Toast product knowledge to facilitate customer demos and ensure the customer is getting the most out of their Toast experience 
  • Partner with internal leadership teams to own customer escalations to resolution, provide regular Voice of Customer feedback, and  facilitate customer references/referrals
  • Build cross-functional partnerships and collaborate closely to engage customers when necessary
  • Lead Strategic Business Reviews built around the customer’s goals, challenges, and trends with senior leaders in the room, ending in decisions and a mutual action plan.

 

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 6+ years account management experience 
  • Mid-Market or Enterprise customer management exper

jobs.description:
We are looking for a consultant who thrives at the intersection of process design, cross-functional coordination, and customer outcomes to guide enterprise customers through their transition to Agentic Workflow Management (AWM). In this role, you will help customers define what AI-powered work looks like for their organization, aligning stakeholders around a shared adoption plan and driving measurable impact across their highest-value workflows. You will design and lead structured, time-bound engagements from onboarding through workflow launch, moving customers to a platform where teams and agents execute work together. Engaging both executive stakeholders and front-line teams, you will operate with strong judgment in ambiguous environments to connect AI capabilities directly to meaningful business results.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Lead structured onboarding engagements by aligning customer stakeholders on platform setup, workflow priorities, and shared success metrics while assessing workflow complexity to target high-impact Asana AI opportunities.
  • Document and transition clear implementation plans that capture prioritized workflows, risk mitigation strategies, and next steps to ensure seamless execution and stakeholder alignment.
  • Guide customers end-to-end through process mapping, hands-on workflow configuration, and user acceptance testing to deliver production-ready workflows with embedded Asana AI capabilities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery across time-bound engagements, aligning workflow owners, IT, business stakeholders, and end users through kickoff, enablement, and launch milestones.
